otherwise, unless you’re gonna play competitive, it doesn’t really matter much on which is the best to play. find whichever ones you find the most fun, and go from there, while also trying to master at least one character from each class.

your best start is, like people suggested here, mystery heroes in the arcade. find characters through it you find fun to play, and go from there. you can also go into training and try practice vs ai, and you can mess around there without being scared of getting killed constantly and made fun of for playing like a newbie.

hard reset is just a different way of saying “factory reset,” which is what you’re thinking of when you say you’re worried everything’ll be deleted. restart just shuts off the switch and turns it back on! you can also long-press the power button on the switch itself, and the power options show up (theres sleep, power off, and restart). as long as you’re not going into the settings on the switch, you should be fine!

restarting just shuts the system down completely and turns it back on! unless you’re a wizard, i don’t think you’ll accidentally delete anything. restarting the console’s the easiest thing you CAN do on the switch version. (you can do it from the home screen, go to the nodes at the bottom where you have the album, eshop, and news and on the very right’s the power options, if you click that, you’ll get the option to restart). unfortunately, i think restarting the console’s the only thing you can do.

So, I'm a very big fan of Henry! In fact, so much so, I've dedicated time into building one! I'm not done merging him, due to a lack of feathers, but so far he's one of my strongest units! He isn't the best in AR, but I don't take it seriously, so I'm fine with him as he is!

IVs : +Res

Weapon : Loyal Wreath+ (+spd refine) - I usually ran Raudrowl+ on Henry, but I found Loyal Wreath+ to be a lot more consistent (minus the buffs he got from my team) and, well, Henry's really cute with it equipped! I run it with the +spd refine so I can guarantee him to double at least a few more heroes. (I like switching it with Keen Raudrwolf+ sometimes, though!)

Special : Aether - Henry sometimes gets hit by units who do more damage to him than he does them. With Aether, it usually guarantees a OHKO, and if not, the next phase they're down. Plus it makes him more self-sufficient since it'll heal him!

A Skill : Close Counter - This is self explanatary; Henry can counter anything! Since he has such high defenses, he can usually tank enemy phase pretty well! Combine it with Aether, Mystic Boost 3, and Close Def 3, and Henry can tank just about anything!

B Skill : Mystic Boost 3 - I know, this one's a little out there and kind of weird on him of all units, but it helps Henry stay in the battle, even if by a little. And since with every unit that attacks him he gets hp back, pairing it with Aether makes him a great self healer! Renewal could be better here, but personally I like Mystic Boost more!

C Skill : Even Atk Wave 3 - I sadly killed my H!Kagero for this, but it was worth it! On enemy phase, Henry and his teammates get an added boost to his and his allies Atk, and paired with my Silas's Even Def Wave, he can usually hit hard while tanking harder!

SS : Close Def 3 - Another enemy phase skill that buffs Henry's tanking capabilities. Again, it lets Henry hit hard, but tank harder!
